{{FIBA Winning Head Coaches}}
[[File:Mike Krzyzewski in 2011 (cropped).jpg|thumb|[[Mike Krzyzewski]] won the title two times in his career.]]
The list of '''FIBA Basketball World Cup winning head coaches''' shows all of the [[head coaches]] that have won the [[FIBA Basketball World Cup]], which is the main international competition for senior men's [[basketball]] national teams, and that is governed by the [[FIBA|International Basketball Federation]] (FIBA).

== Key ==

|-

|Member of both the [[FIBA Hall of Fame]] and the [[List of coaches in the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame|Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame]].
|}
